build_fconv_language_model: build a Fairseq FConvLanguageModel instance using build_model with args and task
add_fconv_lm_args: add FConv language model CLI arguments like dropout and decoder_embed_dim to a parser
configure_base_lm_architecture: configure the base FConv LM architecture with default decoder layers and embedding dimensions
configure_wikitext103_architecture: configure the dauphin WikiText-103 FConv LM architecture with adaptive softmax cutoffs
configure_gbw_architecture: configure the dauphin GBW FConv LM architecture with multi-scale convolution layers
